correctiveTasks: phase-1-task-4: gitLog.txt fixture SHAs are now 39 characters instead of 40. Commit 1 SHA `abc1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234` is 39 chars and commit 3 SHA `789abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcd` is 39 chars. The fix removed 2 characters from each instead of 1. Spec §4 requires full 40-character SHAs. Fix by adding one hex character to each: e.g., `abc1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345` and `789abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcde`.

phaseReports.orchestratorAnalysis: All four phase-2 tasks completed successfully. The core data pipeline is fully implemented with parseGitLog handling the custom git log format (COMMIT_SEPARATOR, BODY_END_MARKER, --stat output) and categorize.ts providing all categorization, TIL extraction, day segment assignment, and diary entry building. 38 tests pass covering all acceptance criteria including edge cases (empty input, malformed blocks, non-UTC offsets, empty bodies, multi-line bodies, TIL deduplication). The only type modification was adding rawTimestamp to Commit, which is a minimal and necessary change for timezone offset preservation.

decisionsLog.text: Added rawTimestamp: string field to Commit type to preserve the timezone offset string from git log output. This is needed by assignDaySegment to compute local hour. The task description suggested this approach ('Consider storing the raw timestamp string on Commit').
FileStat insertions/deletions are parsed by counting + and - characters in the stat line, while total insertions/deletions come from the summary line regex. This matches git --stat output format.
[phase-2-task-2] targetPath renamed: src/__tests__/git.test.ts → src/__tests__/git.test.ts (No correction needed — path matches)

phaseReports.handoff: Phase 2 complete. git.ts parseGitLog parses ---COMMIT--- separated blocks with ---BODY_END--- markers, extracting SHA, subject, body, author, timestamp, rawTimestamp, filesChanged, insertions, and deletions. categorize.ts provides case-insensitive conventional commit categorization, TIL extraction (case-sensitive TIL: prefix), day segment assignment using timezone offset from rawTimestamp, and diary entry building with TIL deduplication. The Commit type now includes a rawTimestamp: string field (added in this phase) to preserve the git author date string including timezone offset. All pure functions are tested and passing.

phaseReports.summary: Implemented all markdown generation functions (formatDiaryEntry, findExistingEntry, replaceEntry, appendEntry) and file I/O functions (readFile, writeFile, fileExists). All 55 tests pass across 4 test files, typecheck clean.
phaseReports.orchestratorAnalysis: All 4 tasks completed successfully. Implementation follows spec §8 precisely: formatDiaryEntry handles TIL sections, multi-repo entries, commit line formatting, empty entry detection. Entry management functions support the replace-confirmation workflow. fileIO.ts is a minimal fs wrapper with no business logic. 55 tests pass, typecheck clean, zero new dependencies.

decisionsLog.text: replaceEntry uses newline splitting and finds next '## ' heading to determine entry block boundaries, matching the spec's description of entry structure
formatDiaryEntry sorts commits by timestamp within each repo section defensively (even though buildRepoEntry already sorts) to ensure correctness regardless of caller
appendEntry handles trailing newline in existing content to avoid double newlines

phaseReports.handoff: Phase 3 complete. markdown.ts provides formatDiaryEntry (generates markdown with date heading, optional TIL section, per-repo commit listings sorted ascending by timestamp, separator), findExistingEntry (scans for date heading), replaceEntry (swaps entry block preserving surrounding content), and appendEntry (creates new file with header or appends to existing). fileIO.ts provides readFile (readFileSync), writeFile (mkdirSync recursive + writeFileSync), and fileExists (existsSync). All functions are pure (markdown.ts) or thin fs wrappers (fileIO.ts) with no cross-module logic leakage. The CLI orchestration layer (cli.ts) can now compose git.ts → categorize.ts → markdown.ts → fileIO.ts for the full pipeline.

phaseReports.summary: Implemented full CLI wiring: parseArgs with flag/positional arg parsing, isValidDate with calendar validation, validateRepoPaths with .git checks, promptReplace with TTY-aware readline, and run orchestrating the full git→categorize→markdown→fileIO pipeline. 19 new tests for cli.ts, all 74 tests pass, typecheck clean, build produces all expected dist/ files with shebang.
phaseReports.orchestratorAnalysis: Phase 4 completed successfully. The code-diary CLI is fully functional.

Exported isValidDate and validateRepoPaths for direct unit testing rather than only testing through parseArgs/run
